name: Quantitative Engineering & Risk Profile
description: Orchestration profile for financial math, PnL, funding, liquidation, backtesting, and risk; currently BLOCKED for live execution until a reviewer proven stronger than the selected worker model is available.

runner_route.unblock_requirement: Provide and mechanically verify a reviewer model/tier proven stronger than the selected worker model in antigravity-sol-quant-runner, with explicit user approval to unblock in core/policy.json. Selecting claude-opus-5-5-high as the worker model does not by itself unblock quant.

tools.name: python3
tools.description: Runtime for verifying reproducible quant datasets and deterministic test suites.

tools.name: git
tools.description: Verify change provenance, file scope, and git diff --check.

candidate_checks.description: Run deterministic test suites with fixed seeds and reproducible datasets in the consumer repository.
Verify the integrity and causal provenance of quantitative datasets.

expected_evidence: Evidence of the 5 quantitative invariants: causal provenance, realistic friction, LONG/SHORT parity, deterministic seeds/tests, and stronger reviewer
Actual exit codes of the deterministic test and reproducible dataset verification commands
Typed evidence triage report from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluations from at least 2 reviewers (including a stronger reviewer)
special_risks: Lookahead bias (leaking future data into decisions at the current timestamp)
Omitting trading fees, slippage, or funding rates, thereby distorting PnL
Formula asymmetry between LONG and SHORT positions or inaccurate liquidation thresholds
Implicitly running quant tasks under a general profile (--work-kind task) or treating two same-model reviewers as a stronger reviewer
quant_escalation_required_when: All tasks involving PnL, funding, liquidation, backtesting, margin, leverage, or risk must directly use the quant profile and --work-kind quant
